The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1926–1927''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]] won this year's championship by beating [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[AFC Ajax]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] and [[Velocitas 1897]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[A.V.& C.V. Robur et Velocitas|Robur et Velocitas]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Groningen|GVAV]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[PSV Eindhoven]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[AFC Ajax]] and [[SBV Excelsior]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VUC (football club)|VUC]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[Koninklijke HFC]] and [[VOC (sports club)|VOC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Hilversum]]
